title: Alexander H. Everett to Henry Clay, Madrid, 25 Sep 1825: three coded passages in the JQA code (catalogue 638)

documents.shelfmark: NARA RG 59, Despatches from US Ministers to Spain vol. 25, M31 reel 27 (naId 188610348), frames 0119-0121, enclosure 'Notes of a Conversation of Mr. Everett with Mr. Zea' (catalogue 638)

plaintext.source: Manning III (1925) doc. 1134 p. 2062 prints passage A as '[Here follow six lines in cipher, without decodification.]'; passages B and C are not printed.

transcription.notes: Contributed by WAINUT (27 Oct 2026). Three passages (A 8 lines, B 14, C 12), checked line by line against the frames a second time, independently. Measured with docs/_check_profile.py --measure --digits --drop-first.

system.summary: John Quincy Adams's numerical syllable-and-word code of 1811-1812 (the = 1385), about 1,600 numbers, rebuilt in ../jqa; used here unchanged.
system.sibling_key: the JQA code, ../jqa/code_table.tsv (rebuilt there from the State Department clerk's decodes and Ford's printed decipherments of JQA's 1811-1812 despatches), applied unchanged
system.notes: distinct_symbols = distinct groups in everett1825_transcription.txt (python docs/_check_profile.py --measure --digits --drop-first; 197 numbers, marked variants counted separately). Marks: lozenge = -s, caret = -ed, cross under 1535 = all and under 1167 = well, tick under a group truncates it.

prior_solution.where: Manning III (1925) doc. 1134 p. 2062 prints passage A undecoded and omits B and C; one web search found no decipherment. Not checked: another copy, a separate State Department file, the Clay Papers. A pencil note 'Decyphered' at the foot of MS p. 4 (frame 0114) suggests a decipherment was made in the Department; it was not found. A parallel independent reading of all the cipher (pp. 1-6, 14-15, 17-18) by Brice Dudout was published the same day as this one (Europe chiffrée, 27 Oct 2026); neither used the other.

conditions.human_role: WAINUT set the task (catalogue 638) and the rules; the AI agents fetched the frames, transcribed, decoded, read and verified. No target-specific human intervention.
models: AI language-model agents (WAINUT); a vision-capable language model for the transcription

solution.what: WAINUT contribution: located catalogue 638 on NARA M31 reel 27 frames 0119-0121 (Everett, Madrid, 25 Sep 1825), in the JQA code (the = 1385).
WAINUT contribution: 355 groups in three passages (A 8 lines, B 14, C 12), checked line by line against the frames a second time, independently.
WAINUT contribution: applied ../jqa/code_table.tsv unchanged: 347 of 355 groups valued, running English in all three passages.
WAINUT contribution: context values marked [?] (666 Zea against March, 70, 1072, and 17 context words); 8 groups open.

WAINUT contribution: wrong-key controls (decode.py --controls): function-word rate 0.37 for the true table, 0.02-0.12 for shifts of 1-100, 0.03-0.05 for random table permutations; an independent character-trigram check (Manning-trained) put the true order at -2.129 against shuffled orders best -2.351.
WAINUT contribution: Manning III doc. 1134 (p. 2062) is an extract that prints passage A undecoded, without passages B and C; one web search found no decipherment.
WAINUT contribution: read in part (everett1825_reading.md, read_share 0.904): 23 holes in about 240 words.

Review check of frames 0112-0118 (catalogue counts from 0114): the same Notes, endorsed as the duplicate sent with despatch No. 7 of 25 Sept 1825, carry further coded passages on MS pp. 1-6 (frames 0112-0115: short runs on pp. 1-3, pp. 4-5 wholly in code, nine lines on p. 6; about 80 lines, very roughly 900 groups); pp. 7-13 are clear. A pencil 'Decyphered' stands at the foot of p. 4. Not transcribed.

Brice Dudout's parallel, independent reading published (https://bdudout.github.io/europe-chiffree/en/documents.html#everett-1825): same table frozen, checked first on the despatch of 8 Sept 1825 against Manning doc. 1133 (288/304 = 0.947, permuted p99 0.023); six lines 72 of 74 groups; pp. 1-6 and 17-18, 1,111 of 1,127 (0.986), with an Everett overlay (727 rather, 1201 g, 557 thro, 948 Russia; ../jqa/overlay_dudout.tsv). Passage A agrees ("a language imposed upon him at present by particular circumstances"); not compared group by group.

texts.label: Everett to Clay, Madrid, 25 Sep 1825 (catalogue 638), M31 reel 27 frames 0119-0121
texts.summary: Everett's notes of a conversation with the foreign minister Zea Bermudez on recognising the new American states: Zea's refusal is a language imposed on him by circumstances; the foreign ministers think him privately favourable but unable to risk his place against his rivals; the influence of Emperor Alexander is directed against recognition, and Russia's policy is put down to opposition to England rather than to legitimacy.

outcome.notes: Contributed by WAINUT (catalogue 638). Same code as ../jqa; nothing there is changed. Proposed table changes (not applied) are in NOTES.md.
